body:
> Do we really want to tie it to stars or shouldn't we do a more generic widget so users can use  or  or whatever?

I think stars are the icon we're used to see the most, I don't remember seeing something else actually :p However, you can still display what you want by replacing the template of the `refinementList` or `starsList`.

> Why not only a 2 css class?

That can still be customized by specifying the cssClass of the `star` and `emptyStar`.
